source: Two direct provider Parquet captures; no WSPRadar analysis result inputs.
original_capture_time_note: Exact network request timestamps were not recorded in a dedicated capture manifest. Filesystem timestamps below identify observed local source-file modification times, not independently authenticated server acquisition times.

frozen_population.selection: Same receiver callsigns and band as original capture, all codes and receiver/transmitter locators, one complete 120-second cycle before and after the demo window. No SNR, peer, distance, activity or minimum-support selection applied.

csv_conversion: Integer values and original strings preserved; Float32 coordinates expanded to their exact Float64 representations before CSV serialization. Use float_precision=round_trip when reading CSV with pandas for exact raw-coordinate checks.

author_correspondence_provenance.scope: Paraphrased date provenance only; no private email files or full messages redistributed. Neither interval below is asserted to be the original seven-day publication dataset.
author_correspondence_provenance.unresolved: The provenance does not independently identify the hardware state during every earlier day of the chosen seven-day archive reconstruction.
author_correspondence_provenance.time_zone_note: Correspondence does not explicitly label timezone; current reconstruction interprets WSPR timestamps as UTC.

transport.evidence: Confirmed by capturing parent task for both source requests.

independent_builder.verification: All ten expected files regenerate byte-identically; independent table totals and component identities checked. Standard-library imports only.
